CA.rationale: Content (red at coordinates) and a processing/origin tag (command_estimate) are explicitly linked for the same candidate referent.

COD.rationale: Content assignments, an explicit origin/organization field, and separate status-like fields are present for the same referent/represented_time.

A.rationale: Processing/origin tags (command_estimate, history_estimate) are explicitly associated with the same content referents, indicating processing/attention-related conditions tied to presentation.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content assignments (red/blue at coordinates) are present with literal color attribute labels and coordinate lists.

D.rationale: Content assignments and separate origin/organization/status fields are provided for the same referents, distinguishing content identity from organizational/status metadata.

O.rationale: The text explicitly describes how content is organized/presented (grid orientation) and provides origin/representation metadata tying presentation to record kinds/times.
